header.name: Integrated Circuit Fabrication
header.description: In this course fundamental physical and chemical processes will be used to describe and model a range of fabrication processes making up the various silicon integrated circuit technologies. This course covers everything that professionals need to know, from crystal growth to integrated devices and circuits. Both theory and the practical aspects of each major fabrication step, including crystal growth, silicon oxidation, photolithography, etching, diffusion, ion implantation, and thin film deposition will be covered in this course. It is assumed that students have a quantitative understanding of the basic device physics and structure of diodes, bipolar junction and field-effect transistors
prerequisites_desirable: Solid State Devices & Semiconductor Physics or instructor can give other
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Solid State Devices & Semiconductor Physics or instructor can give other

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to identify IC production cycle, and describe prevaling semiconductor technologies and their role in device processing and trends; to classify various semiconductor material and identify defects in semiconductor materials

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to determine and develope process parameter for thermal oxidation process, metallization process, photolithography, Etching and diffusion process

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Ability to design the ion implantation process and identify the implant damage and implement techniques for removing the damage; Ability to generate the flow of IC fabrication process and generate specifications for fabrication of IC resistors, capacitr and inductors;

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Abilito to plan processing steps for BJT, MOSFET, BiCMOS, BEOL, SOI, FinFET and MESFET fabrication and choose correct packaging for production

lecture_topics: Crystal structure, crystal axis and plane, crystal defect and defect electronic properties
Crystal Growth – Elementary material, growth from liquid and doping in liquid state
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Reading Assignment, Group assignment (Simulation I), Quiz 1

lecture_topics: Photolithography – Optical lithography, Pattern generation and mask making printing problems, New techniques in lithography
Etching – Wet chemical etching, dry etching, microelectromechanical systems
Diffusion – Basic diffussion process, extrinsic diffussion, diffussion related process, Silicon and GaAs impurity behaviour
Ion Implantation – Basic of ion implantation, range of implanted ions, implant damage and annealing, implantation related process
Process Integration – IC fabrication process, mask layout, isolation techniques, Passive components

S. M. Sze – Semiconductor Devices Physics and Technology, John Wiley, 2nd Ed. 2002
S. K. Ghandi – VLSI Fabrication principles, John Wiley, 1993
W. Runyan and K. Bean, Semiconductor Integrated Circuit Processing Technology, Addison Wesley, 1990
